description: This Kotlin source file defines a data class 'DeviceIdentity' and a class 'DeviceIdentityStore' responsible for managing device identity information, including creation, storage, signing, and verification using cryptographic keys. It interacts with the filesystem, performs cryptographic operations with BouncyCastle, and handles JSON serialization.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A serializable data class that holds device identification details including deviceId, public and private keys in base64 strings, and a creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: A class responsible for loading, creating, saving, and cryptographically handling device identity data, including generating key pairs, signing payloads, and verifying signatures.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists, updating cached data accordingly.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key with Ed25519 algorithm, returning a base64 URL-safe signature.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature for a payload using the device's public key.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the public key encoded in URL-safe base64 format.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Reads and deserializes the device identity from the file.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Helper for reading and parsing a device identity from a file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and writes the device identity to the file.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new Ed25519 key pair, derives deviceId via SHA-256, and encodes keys for storage.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Derives deviceId from public key raw bytes by hashing with SHA-256.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of data and encodes it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a URL-safe Base64 string.
